newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks pare early gains on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks pare early gains on profit-taking.

text.p: Mexican stocks rose Thursday but ended off their highest levels of the day.
The blue chip IPC index closed up 15.03 points at 3,373.35.

"I still see the bolsa's prospects for further gains as very good on the whole," said Gerardo Copca, reserach director at the Valores Finamex brokerage. "For the moment, people don't like all the fuss about the exchange rate and some prefer to take liquidty and sit out."
Among gainers, bank stock Intenal B rose after the bank said it would expand its branch network by 50 percent in 1997. Intenal gained 88 centavos ($0.12) to 6.48 pesos ($0.86).
Bottler Gemex gained 50 centavos ($0.07) to 11.00 pesos ($1.46) based on a favourable outlook for its third-quarter earnings report, traders said.

Technical analysts noted that the IPC broke through a resistance at 3,360 points.They also pointed out that even though volume was not as high as on Wednesday, enough foreign buyers did step in at one stage to push the IPC up to a session high of 3,391.48 points.
Volume was 97.5 million shares traded. A total of 120 shares were traded, of which gainers outnumberd losers 52 to 48, with 20 unchanged.
